images.name: hero-pumpkin-wide
images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a new luxury private-chef website hero photograph, using the reference ONLY for the dark bronze stone tabletop, warm low-key side light and refined editorial photographic style. Replace ALL the fish curry and appam with a SINGLE complete matte dark-charcoal ceramic bowl containing silky smooth roasted PUMPKIN SOUP, rich natural golden-orange in colour. Garnish on the surface with clearly identifiable golden-brown ROASTED CASHEW HALVES, lightly toasted PUMPKIN SEEDS (pepitas), and a refined drizzle plus small droplets of vibrant GREEN HERB OIL. The nuts and seeds should be a restrained appetising cluster, with green oil delicately tracing the orange soup. Realistic food texture and natural shadows, premium restaurant plating, entirely credible edible presentation. Show the complete bowl and all rim edges, with space around it. There must be NO fish, NO seafood, NO curry leaves, NO appam, NO bread, NO side plate, NO cream swirl, NO hands, NO lettering, NO logo, NO watermark or UI. The entire scene is one coherent photograph of soup on a stone table, not a collage. Landscape desktop hero composition, 16:9. Wide establishing view, not a macro. Place the complete bowl around 60% across the image, slightly below centre; its width approximately 38% of the image. Left third and upper part show quiet naturally textured dark stone table for typography. The stone surface fills the full landscape edge to edge.
